Explain in your own words what 'Realisation Expenses and Remuneration' refers to.
questions.a: Wind-up costs paid by the firm hit the realisation account; costs paid by a partner on the firm's behalf are credited to that partner; a fixed remuneration for doing the work goes to the realisation account, and actual spending by the remunerated partner is not recorded again.

questions.q: State the single key point to remember about 'Realisation Expenses and Remuneration'.
questions.a: Whichever way expenses are arranged, only one of remuneration or actual expense ever reaches the account twice.
